en: Black‑and‑white real‑photo image of a Catholic church interior. It shows a vaulted Gothic apse with two stained‑glass lancet windows flanking a tall carved winged altarpiece (retable). The retable features a crowned Madonna and Child at center, flanked by crowned saints, with small apostles below and spired canopies above. Tall altar candles, an embroidered altar cloth with floral motifs, carved choir stalls, and flower arrangements are visible.
